submissionPrivacy.title: Submission privacy
submissionPrivacy.description: How Artan Records handles artist enquiries and submitted work.

sections.title: Your enquiry
sections.text: Artan Records uses your name, contact details, introduction and submitted links to review your work and respond. Sending an enquiry does not publish a profile or create an offer of representation.

sections.title: Processing and storage
sections.text: The form uses Google Apps Script to store submissions in a private Google Sheet and send a notification to our collaboration inbox, hosted by iCloud. Applications are not added to this website's public repository.

sections.title: Verification
sections.text: Opening the form loads Google reCAPTCHA to help prevent spam and abuse. It processes browser and interaction information and uses a necessary verification cookie. Verification is required before an enquiry can be accepted.

sections.title: What to share
sections.text: Share listening links, not private masters, project files or sensitive documents. Include only work and information you have permission to share.

sections.title: Contact
sections.text: To ask about your enquiry or request access, correction or deletion, contact collaborate@artanrecords.com.

channels.title: The music comes first.
channels.description: Send your artist name, a short introduction and a listening link. Singles, EPs and albums can begin here. We listen and review enquiries individually: this is a conversation, not automatic distribution.
channels.detail: Share links, not private masters or project files.

channels.title: A clear next step. Together.
channels.description: If there is a fit, we discuss your project, credits, artwork and release plans. The scope, responsibilities and commercial terms must be agreed before an engagement begins.
channels.detail: Submission is not acceptance. Promotion is not automatically included.

channels.title: Beyond the recording.
channels.description: Sound and image belong in the same conversation. We welcome creative collaborators alongside recording artists. Share a portfolio and tell us what you would like to make together.
channels.detail: Artists, musicians and visual collaborators are welcome.
